values: « Conclure » can mean to draw a conclusion or to finalize an agreement or contract.
Use « condamner quelqu’un à + penalty » for sentencing, and « condamner » alone can also mean to condemn or denounce.
Besides driving a vehicle, « conduire » can mean to lead or take someone somewhere; it normally takes a direct object.
Use « confier quelque chose à quelqu’un » to entrust something to someone; « se confier à » means to confide in someone.
A common construction is « conseiller à quelqu’un de + infinitif »; « conseiller quelque chose » means to recommend something.
« Consulter » can mean to seek advice from a person or to look up information in a reference source.
Use « correspondre à » for matching or corresponding to something, and « correspondre avec » for exchanging letters or messages with someone.
The thing that has a price is the subject: « Ce livre coûte vingt euros. »
« Craindre que » is normally followed by the subjunctive; formal French may add an expletive « ne » without changing the negative meaning.
